definition: Waikato Environment for Knowledge Analysis (Weka) is a collection of machine learning and data analysis free software licensed under the GNU General Public License.
details: It was developed at the University of Waikato, New Zealand, and is the companion software to the book "Data Mining: Practical Machine Learning Tools and Techniques".
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. And that is Weka (software) — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
